title: Otiartes
summary: Antediluvian Chaldean king, father of Xisuthrus. Apollodorus calls him Otiartes and gives a length; Polyhistor calls the ninth king Ardates and gives none.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 52; Berossus, ap. Apollodorus, ap. Syncellus and Eusebius
reign.note: Otiartes, a Chaldæan from Laranchae. Polyhistor (p. 60) calls the ninth king Ardates and gives him no length.
